pxdesign.omitted_note: left out of the archive and of stock/src: two font files of upstream's pxd_server module, read only for the `pxdesign pipeline` verb's summary figure and the web UI, neither of which this kit installs for or runs (STOCK.md Pin); the pin check compares source files only, so an installed checkout that carries them passes unchanged

pxdbench.fetched: from the repository at install, at this commit (environment/requirements.lock); no copy of PXDesignBench is carried in this tree; the pin check verifies the installed version and the checked-out commit

archive_recipe: git archive --format=tar --prefix=<name>-<commit8>/ <commit> <paths> | gzip -n -9  (PXDesign: pxdesign setup.py README.md LICENSE requirements.txt install.sh examples ':(exclude)pxdesign/pxd_server/Helvetica-Regular.ttf' ':(exclude)pxdesign/pxd_server/TimesNewRoman.ttf' — the pinned commit minus the two font files named under upstream.pxdesign.omitted; Protenix: protenix setup.py README.md LICENSE requirements.txt); stock/src/<Repo>/ is the extraction of each archive without its prefix directory. PXDesignBench has no archive and no extraction here: it is fetched from its repository at install and pinned by version and commit

pinned_stack.freeze: environment/requirements.lock: the tested stack's `pip freeze --all` (environment/Dockerfile installs it with --no-deps; README.md 'Setup')
pinned_stack.tested_on: one NVIDIA H100 80GB in a container built from the pinned block above; a record, compared by nothing

checkpoint.upstream_default_dir: <repo>/release_data/checkpoint (configs/configs_infer.py:27); upstream downloads into --load_checkpoint_dir when the file is absent (utils/infer.py:61-105) — the tree refuses before any download

required_in_dir.source: https://pxdesign.tos-cn-beijing.volces.com/release_model/ (pxdesign/utils/infer.py:39-41); every pxdesign infer run requires them in --load_checkpoint_dir and downloads any absent one (runner/inference.py:213 -> utils/infer.py:119-131); the sampler loads pxdesign_v0.1.0.pt alone (runner/inference.py:90-101)

ccd_cache.source: https://pxdesign.tos-cn-beijing.volces.com/release_data/ (pxdesign/utils/infer.py:42-44; the endpoint publishes no hashes); read by protenix/data/ccd.py and protenix/data/utils.py
